turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, is this Mrs. Iyer from Delhi? This is Sameer from the Digital Security Wing regarding your banking app.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, I am Mrs. Iyer. What is the problem? Everything is working fine.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Actually, we have detected a security loophole in your version of the app that could lead to unauthorized access. I need to push a quick security patch to your phone right now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: A patch? I do not understand. Can I not just go to the bank branch tomorrow?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is very urgent, Ma'am, otherwise the account might be frozen for twenty four hours. Please just download an app called AnyDesk from the Play Store so I can secure it for you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: AnyDesk? I have never heard of this. Is it safe to let you see my screen?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is completely safe and official. Just give me the nine digit code showing on your screen and I will handle the rest.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, it says 492 105 837. Please do it quickly, I am getting worried.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am in your system now. To activate the security shield, you must make a verification payment of nine thousand five hundred rupees to the server.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Payment? You said it was a patch. Why should I pay for a security update?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is just a refundable deposit to verify your account ownership. Please tell me your UPI PIN so I can process this refund immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am not sure about this. Let me call my son first.
